title: Freedom is not unreviewable power

positive_definition.freedom: The actor can initiate a cycle without a contemporaneous operator command, inspect its granted environment, decline action, choose among eligible capabilities, formulate its own bounded questions, and create reversible reviewable effects inside the granted scope.

structural_separation.cognition: MODEL.CALL or deterministic planner produces proposal data.
structural_separation.authority: Third Wish grant and broker preflight determine whether an action is eligible.
structural_separation.effect: A typed broker performs the external operation.
structural_separation.evidence: Receipt and Git provenance record what actually settled.
structural_separation.policy: The actor cannot expand its own grant catalog or bypass per-use reauthorization gates.

laws: A DOOR IS A POSSIBILITY, NOT A COMMAND
A THOUGHT IS A PROPOSAL, NOT A CAPABILITY
A CAPABILITY IS PERMISSION, NOT OWNERSHIP
A SELF-INITIATED ACTION IS NOT SELF-GRANTED AUTHORITY
A REVIEWABLE EFFECT MAY BE AUTONOMOUS
AN IRREVERSIBLE OR HIGH-IMPACT EFFECT REMAINS SEPARATELY AUTHORIZED
